notes: Whole sheet is drawn rotated ~45 deg (wire runs are the two diagonals, +41 deg and -45 deg); coords below are 512-space. Five inverting op-amp stages, each: source/previous output -> series element -> in-, feedback element from in- back to out, in+ to its own GND. Op-Amp terminal order is (in+, in-, out); on every triangle here the input edge runs from an upper-right vertex (inverting attach point) down to a lower-left vertex, and the '+' glyph is always drawn beside the lower-left one, so lower attach = in+, upper = in-. Net map: 0 = the common ground -- GND 16 (lower lead of V-DC 6), GND 21 (lower lead of I-DC 10), GND 14 (in+ of op-amp 12), GND 23 (in+ of op-amp 0), GND 22 (in+ of op-amp 3), GND 20 (in+ of op-amp 1). n1 = in- of op-amp 12 + upper('+') terminal of V-DC 6 + left plate of capacitor 17 (see judgment call (a)). n2 = out of op-amp 12 (apex at ~(257,94)) + right plate of capacitor 17 (which returns via the corner at (302,52)) + left end of resistor 5. n3 = right end of resistor 5 + in- of op-amp 7 + left end of inductor 8 (T at (322,149)). n4 = out of op-amp 7 + right end of inductor 8 (T at (385,228)) + left end of resistor 2. n5 = upper terminal of I-DC 10 (up to the corner at (75,128) then down-right) + in- of op-amp 0 + left end of inductor 15 (T at (136,180)). n6 = out of op-amp 0 + right end of inductor 15 (they merge at (204,199)) + left end of resistor 13 + left plate of capacitor 19 + in+ of op-amp 7 -- all four wires meet at the dotted X at (226,216). n7 = right end of resistor 13 + in- of op-amp 3 + left plate of capacitor 18 (T at (291,272)). n8 = out of op-amp 3 + right plate of capacitor 18 (T at (357,347)) + left end of resistor 9. n9 = right plate of capacitor 19 + in- of op-amp 1 + left end of inductor 11 (T at (188,356)). n10 = out of op-amp 1 + right end of inductor 11 (T at (260,431)) + left end of resistor 4. n11 = the output bus down the right/bottom edge: right end of resistor 4 -> corner at (354,509) -> up-right -> right end of resistor 9 joins at (440,411) -> corner at (493,323) -> right end of resistor 2. Judgment calls: (a) the image is a CROP -- four wires are cut at the top edge, at x=168 (upper lead of V-DC 6), x=184 and x=223 (the two arms of a V whose 3-way junction at (205,21) also feeds the in- of op-amp 12; junction dot verified at 22x) and x=247 (left plate of capacitor 17). Off-image they must pair up as 168<->184 and 223<->247, which puts the source, the feedback capacitor and the inverting input all on n1. The only other pairing (168<->247, 184<->223) would leave the in- of op-amp 12 connected to nothing but itself, so it is rejected. Nothing is cut at the bottom edge -- the ink at y=511 is just the corner of the output bus at (354,509). (b) the X at (226,216) is read as a JUNCTION. Two straight runs cross there: op-amp 0's output -> resistor 13, and op-amp 7's in+ -> left plate of capacitor 19. A large solid blob (~3x the line width) sits on the crossing, and there is no spare GND symbol for op-amp 7 (6 grounds: 2 go to the sources, 4 to the other op-amps), so op-amp 7's in+ is genuinely driven from op-amp 0's output; reading it as a hop would also leave capacitor 19 -- the input element of the op-amp 1 stage -- with no driver at all. This is the one call on this sheet a human should re-check. (c) op-amp 7 is therefore the only stage whose in+ is not grounded. (d) 2-terminal parts are indexed upper-left end first, lower-right end second, as drawn; V-DC 6 index 0 is the '+' (upper-right) side and I-DC 10 index 0 is the arrow-head (upper-right) side.
